Retried again with a wider, contrast-enhanced crop preserving the minus glyph -- OCR still misread it entirely ('1').

Searched subsequent frames (t=62s-96s) for a positive-valued, contract-covered control (oscA.warp_amount, mentioned as '28%' in the transcript) with a static/tooltip numeric readout -- none of the inspected frames showed a legible numeric overlay for it (menu navigation and an unrelated LFO curve edit were in progress instead).
All attempts used only real, unmodified evidence and the real, unmodified observation_engine/observation_policy -- no fabricated values, no bypassed adjudication, no architecture changes.
blocker.conclusion: Genuine, reproducible stop condition given the evidence collected in this session. Not fixed by weakening the architecture (explicitly prohibited) or fabricating evidence (also prohibited). Legitimate next steps: (a) expand the inspected-frame set toward the full 269 to find a naturally-corroborated, contract-covered control elsewhere in the video, or (b) target frames with clean positive-valued static numeric readouts (avoiding OCR's demonstrated weakness on the minus-sign glyph at this resolution).
